ns0:svg.ns0:title: Independent stochastic simulation with OP Engine
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: 512 independent exact stochastic transfer simulations, their empirical mean and pointwise 5th–95th percentile range, and the final distribution alongside analytic mean and binomial references. Synthetic demonstration.
